title: Minimalist Retail Storefront System
summary: A clean digital catalog and shopping cart architecture focused on effortless product discovery, variant selection, and mobile checkout speed.
challenge: Cluttered online stores with heavy scripts create friction on mobile networks and obscure product photography.
solution: Built a streamlined storefront layout prioritizing crisp product grids, instant category filtering, and an uncluttered cart experience.
